subtasks.description: Declare the four 32-bit round key registers (rk0, rk1, rk2, rk3) and all intermediate wires: rot_word, sbox_byte0..3, rcon_out, T_word, rk0_next..rk3_next.
constraints: Interface signals must exactly match the port list in S003.
Declare exactly four 32-bit registers (rk0..rk3) and the required intermediate wires as per S016.

subtasks.description: Instantiate one aes_rcon and four aes_sbox submodules, connecting their ports to the declared wires according to the interfaces specified in S012 and S014.
constraints: Use exact port mappings as defined in aes_rcon interface (S012) and aes_sbox interface (S014); do not add extra instances.

subtasks.description: Compute rot_word as a one-byte left-rotate of rk3, assemble sub_word from the four sbox_byte outputs, and XOR with rcon_out to produce T_word.
constraints: RotWord: rot_word = {rk3[23:0], rk3[31:24]} exactly per S005.
SubWord byte ordering must be {sbox_byte0, sbox_byte1, sbox_byte2, sbox_byte3} as specified in S009.

subtasks.description: Compute next round key words using the AES expansion recurrence: rk0_next = rk0 ^ T_word; rk1_next = rk1 ^ rk0_next; rk2_next = rk2 ^ rk1_next; rk3_next = rk3 ^ rk2_next.
constraints: The recurrence must exactly follow the algorithm in S005: rk0_next = rk0 ^ T_word; rk1_next = rk1 ^ rk0_next; rk2_next = rk2 ^ rk1_next; rk3_next = rk3 ^ rk2_next.

subtasks.description: On rising clock edge, load rk0..rk3 with the input key when kld=1 (per key loading in S007), or update with computed next-key words when kld=0 (per expansion operation in S008).
constraints: Synchronous update only; no asynchronous reset.
Key loading must divide input key as key[127:96]→rk0, key[95:64]→rk1, key[63:32]→rk2, key[31:0]→rk3 exactly as in S007.
Expansion update must occur on the cycle immediately following kld deassertion.

subtasks.description: Assign the output ports wo_0, wo_1, wo_2, wo_3 directly from the current register values rk0, rk1, rk2, rk3 respectively.
constraints: Outputs must continuously reflect the current rk registers as per interface S003.
